finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Retreat, my brethren! Return to the clan, and tell the Warlord I’ve joined the Ancestors!”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: The voice of the Chieftain echoed through the jungle for a few seconds as his head fell down, limp, all signs of life leaving his body.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “So I die... with honor,” the Chieftain smiled as his eyes closed for a moment. He seemed to gather his last strength as he yelled loudly.
